scope: Parse existing official artifacts and source only; no SQL/parser package imports, solver, installation, training or queue

selection_rule.eligibility: Either original SQL string has lexical JOIN token AND either SQL has COUNT/SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX followed by open parenthesis. Lexical screen only, not parser/support proof. Original record and all database DDL must be present; malformed/missing entries remain in denominator.
selection_rule.diversity: max 2 per dbid including anchor, applied greedily in stratum order
selection_rule.no_refill: No outcome-driven replacement. Short strata remain short. No changing rule after viewing extraction.
selection_rule.dedup: Skip exact unordered query-pair hash duplicates and anchor; report skips. Semantic duplicates unverified.

exposure: All source records inspected by extractor count as exposed development material; all selected cases development. No independent test claims even if source IDs differ from 1172.
future_pick_rule: For next experiment, first selected official NEQ case in frozen rank with exact source C and manually established static no-known-SQL-operator blocker for Polygon; if none, first selected EQ in same eligibility, excluding anchor. Choice cannot use candidate method performance.
stop: At most this existing 1534-record package and fixed local tests/source files; no retrieval of additional result archives or experiments.
prior_outcome_exposure: 1172 and prior 138 aggregate-DISTINCT official summary already seen; this is a declared diagnostic sample, not pre-label natural evaluation.
